ai_summary: **Executive Summary: CG Power and Industrial Solutions Limited 89th AGM**  CG Power and Industrial Solutions Limited conducted its 89th Annual General Meeting virtually on July 24, 2026, where shareholders approved the unqualified FY26 standalone and consolidated financial statements and confirmed an interim dividend of ₹1.30 per share. Key resolutions included the re-appointment of Director Vellayan Subbiah and ratification of the Cost Auditor's remuneration, underscoring continuity in leadership and strong financial health given the clean audit reports. The only minor observation was the absence of two independent directors for personal reasons, which does not indicate any material operational or financial impact.
